neck.curve_convention: 64 ellipse samples; last connects to first

specification.graph_policy: Preserve every incident edge and outlet; sac is a lesion, not a daughter artery

projection.normalization: Exact duplicate coordinates welded; original triangle order and positions preserved
projection.limitation: Finite-precision triangle ray hits; between-sample attachment and tangent continuity unverified. Multiple or grazing exits are unresolved. No surface trimming or lumen union.
